name: Fergie Baby Harlem Walk AI
blurb: One photo in: you swagger down a Harlem park path, rapping into the camera like the album just dropped.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, build and clothes. They walk down a paved path in a New York city park on a bright autumn afternoon: a tall chain-link fence and a basketball court on one side, trees with yellow leaves on the other, red-brick apartment towers rising behind the trees, fallen leaves on the ground. The camera walks backward in front of them at chest height, full body in frame. (1) They stroll toward the camera with a slow, bouncing swagger, shoulders rolling, head nodding to the beat; (2) they rap straight into the lens, mouth moving with the words, pointing at the camera with one hand, then tapping their chest twice; (3) they spread both arms wide, grin, and keep strutting toward the camera, nodding. Their face stays clearly visible the whole time. One continuous handheld shot, vertical 9:16. A hard New York hip-hop beat in the audio. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
